contract.selection_policy: Explicit selection only. Normal and not-assessed exclude findings within the same section.
contract.context_policy: Unenumerated source placeholders require external context. They must not be guessed, auto-filled, silently omitted, or rendered as text inputs.
contract.number_policy: Only actual supplied measurements; no numeric defaults. A number picker is an input method, not a measurement source.
contract.report_policy: All slots in selected statements must resolve before a report is complete. Preserve source statement wording.
